text: Following the impacts of Tropical Cyclone Alfred in March 2025, the NSW Reconstruction Authority activated Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) Category B to fund urban drainage repairs and related flood-recovery works in New South Wales. This initiative includes a regulatory change allowing councils to request a special variation to reallocate funds from council waste funds to general funds, enabling co-funding of urgent urban drainage needs. Additionally, a Community Relief Program provides up to $1 million per impacted council for clean-up and make-safe funding for council-managed assets not covered by other packages.
